INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Only memorise without using the language
   B. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   C. Mix random languages with no purpose
   D. Avoid speaking to classmates

2. When practising Reading 1.2.1 Reading comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 1.2.1 Reading comprehension.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 1.2.1 Reading comprehension.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Reading 1.2.1 Reading comprehension.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Reading 1.2.1 Reading comprehension.
